summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three keyword rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py), with matching test modules in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. All 72 ECS tests pass with PYTHONPATH set to this repo's src/. Nothing is committed. Not verified: black and ruff are not in the venv, so only line length was checked by hand. Five unit/integration tests fail, mostly for environment reasons (graphviz, junit_xml, defusedxml missing); the two quickstart integration tests run the venv's base/ cfn-lint copy, so they don't exercise this change, and I did not confirm them against a clean baseline. A full-fixture lint scan was stopped at its time limit and not restarted; a targeted scan of ECS-related fixtures found no hits from the new rules.
